method: three passes over the hostnames this repository's own scan of 2,017 mainland origins collected: leading labels matching advertising-delivery conventions, leading labels matching tracking and analytics conventions, and hostnames sharing a registrable root with an endpoint the product still routes direct. Every candidate is reviewed per host, required to be third-party to at least one observing origin, and checked for a live A record.
